02 / CREATE A COIN

From idea to wallet approval.

01

Give it an identity.

Upload a PNG, JPG or WebP up to 8 MB. It is automatically optimized for your token. Add a name, ticker and short description.

02

Add the extras.

Website and X links are optional. Add a developer buy in COINx, or leave it at zero.

03

Approve the launch.

Connect your wallet and sign the ownership message if prompted. Then review and sign the launch transaction.

04

Meet your coin.

Wait for finality. Your token page shows its mint, verified market observations and a link to trade on Pump.

Two different balances.

SOL pays account creation and network fees. COINx is needed only if you choose a developer buy.

Developer buys, metadata and interrupted launches

An optional developer buy is included in the creation transaction. Its amount is a spending cap; Pump may spend less. There is no separate liquidity deposit or 50% developer-buy split.

Your saved PFP and links are pinned to the mint through content-addressed metadata. Launch preparation verifies that the embedded metadata has no update authority. Memebase hosts the metadata; it is not permanent decentralized storage.

If you reject a signature or a transaction expires, reopen the token page. Memebase reconciles the previous preparation before creating a replacement. Do not repeatedly submit the same launch while confirmation is pending.

New coins use Pump’s Token-2022 flow, six token decimals and its standard supply. Mayhem mode and holder rewards are disabled.

03 / COINX PAIRINGS

What “paired with COINx” means.

Your meme coin is the base asset. COINx is the quote asset—the token used to buy it, sell it and express its price.

COINx

The market’s quote.

Prices, market caps, reserves and indexed volume are shown in COINx.

SOL

The network’s fuel.

SOL pays Solana rent and transaction fees. It is not the quote for new Memebase pairs.

COINx · SOLANA MAINNETXs7ZdzSHLU9ftNJsii5fCeJhoRWSC32SQGzGQtePxNu
COINx moves in price.

COINx is a tokenized equity asset associated with Coinbase stock. It is not USDC or a dollar stablecoin. A COINx pair does not make your meme coin stable.

Quote verification and legacy USDC coins

COINx is listed in Pump’s quote-control configuration. It uses Token-2022 and eight decimals. Memebase checks the quote configuration when preparing a launch.

Legacy BlueMint tokens keep their original on-chain USDC pools and metadata, but their listings are retired from Memebase. Legacy USDC fee claims remain separate.

04 / FEES

Pump fees. No extra Memebase trading fee.

New launches follow Pump’s on-chain trading fee schedule. Your launch wallet is the coin creator and receives eligible creator fees under Pump’s rules.

Network fees & account creationPaid in SOL to use Solana

Legacy USDC claims

The former BlueMint LaunchLab markets retain their original 1.25% platform fee and zero creator fee. Their USDC claims go to the existing treasury. The old 40% / 60% allocation does not apply to new Pump coins.

06 / LIQUIDITY

A curve first. A pool next.

01CREATE
02PUMP CURVE
03PUMPSWAP

Trading starts on Pump’s bonding curve. Buys add quote reserves and release tokens; sells move in the opposite direction.

When the curve completes, Pump’s migration process creates its canonical PumpSwap market. A short interval can occur before that pool becomes available. Memebase checks its pool and vault balances after migration.

Liquidity follows Pump’s rules.

No automatic Memebase COINx buyback, fee reinvestment, holder rewards or price floor is enabled. The optional developer buy is a purchase, not a separate liquidity commitment.

07 / CHARTS & THE CROWN

Read the market. Watch the throne.

Price & market cap

Verified finalized reserves determine the quote price. Market cap is that price multiplied by supply.

Candles & reserves

One-minute candles summarize available price observations and indexed curve trades. Reserves show the quote liquidity available to the market, excluding identifiable pool fees.

ROLLING FIVE MINUTES

King of Memes.

The COINx coin with the highest indexed volume in the last five minutes takes the crown. The board refreshes every 15 seconds.

A ≥ before volume means partial history. “Indexing” means the data is unavailable, rather than zero. New finalized curve and PumpSwap trades are indexed, with bounded HTTP backfill; reconnects and history gaps can leave incomplete volume.

Which coins qualify, and where can I trade?

The crown considers listed Memebase COINx coins with positive recent indexed volume. Legacy USDC markets are excluded. If there are no eligible trades, the throne stays open.

Use Trade on Pump from a token’s page. Axiom and other terminals control their own quote support and indexing; Memebase cannot force their availability.

Every finalized token has a mint-address page at /token/<mint-address>. Retired legacy markets keep their original on-chain mint and pool addresses.
